philosophy.notes: Study-first mobile flashcard posture with warm accent canvas; exam screens deliberately muted and slate-backed as secondary language.

hierarchy.notes: Thumb toolbar anchors primary actions; flashcard front/back separation keeps stem then reveal path obvious on 390px.

typography.notes: Fraunces headlines, Plex body/mono stats; long stem cctc-6198 drops to smaller size with maintained line-height.

motion.notes: Card flip on reveal with reduced-motion fallback; bottom-sheet modals for navigator/submit/flag feel native on phone.

brand.notes: CCTC tokens bound (--accent #d79548, --brand #123b3a); prototype banner and unofficial disclaimer present on score/home.
